facts.fact: StackAdapt's research with Advertiser Perceptions found that 50% of advertisers who implemented a multi-channel advertising strategy saw a better return on investment (ROI).
facts.quote: 50% of advertisers who have implemented a multi-channel advertising strategy saw a better return on investment (ROI).

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's report with Advertiser Perceptions, 40% of advertisers will increase their programmatic ad spend in the next 12 months.
facts.quote: A better ROI is also why 40% of advertisers will increase their programmatic ad spend in the next 12 months.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's report, 60% of marketers believe multi-channel campaigns achieve or exceed their KPIs at least most of the time.
facts.quote: 60% of marketers believe multi-channel campaigns achieve or exceed their key performance indicators (KPIs) at least most of the time.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's report found that more than 40% of advertisers believe multi-channel advertising is extremely important for achieving upper- and lower-funnel goals.
facts.quote: more than 40% of advertisers believe multi-channel advertising is extremely important in achieving upper- and lower-funnel goals.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's report found that 33% of advertisers view multi-channel advertising as extremely important for mid-funnel goals.
facts.quote: 33% view multi-channel advertising as extremely important for mid-funnel goals.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's report found that advertisers have difficulty measuring their goals across different channels.
facts.quote: The report found that advertisers have difficulty measuring their goals across different channels.
